title: caucalis scabra
intro: Caucalis scabra, commonly known as rough melick or rough mouse-ear, is a flowering plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Caucalis scabra include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects.
